No commits, pushes or merges unless the owner authorizes them for a run
Not an LLM; model work stays in the role agents
One dashboard across projects: roadmaps, decisions and live relays with every agent, stage and progress

Set up, launch and supervise parallel slice waves across vendors, owner-attended at checkpoints

No scheduler: ork does not pick and run waves on its own
